notes.title: Star Trek: Resurgence // Enhancement Update
notes.notes:
You asked, and we listened! The Resurgence [b]Enhancement Update[/b] is now on Steam with new features to enhance your experience aboard the [i]USS Resolute[/i].

[list]
[*] Achievements Engaged: Show off your skills and dedication with all-new achievements.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Choose from four graphics pre-sets: Minimum, Standard, High, and Maximum – tailor your game visuals to your taste and your system’s performance capabilities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Take control of V-Sync: Toggle it on or off to find the perfect balance of smoothness and performance.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Enjoy enhanced performance across the board, including a smoother experience on Steam Deck.
[/list]

Your ongoing feedback is invaluable, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of these enhancements.

[b]Please note[/b]: Achievements can only be acquired via a NEW play-through of the game. So, now's the chance to make some different decisions to see what will happen to you and your crewmates aboard the Resolute! 

LLAP - The ST: R team

notes.title: Disengage docking clamps. Engage thrusters on my mark...
notes.notes:
It's been a long road, getting from there to here...

But we're finally on Steam! First of all, thank [b]YOU[/b] for being interested in our game. 

Star Trek: Resurgence was made by fans for fans. 

The initial heartbeat of this game probably started when we were all at Telltale Games. Dramatic Labs is a small, independent studio of former Telltale devs and while we don't have the resources of our former employer, we put an enormous amount of passion into this game. We love telling stories and having you, the player, choose how they develop. So, we hope that you finish this game feeling like you were part of a TNG-era show or movie. If you do, then we've succeeded. 

It's been a wonderful journey, one that included working with the Star Trek Titan that is Jonathan Frakes (see what we did there?), attempting to do honor to the performance of Leonard Nimoy through the wonderful talents of Piotr Michael, and collaborating with our friends on the Star Trek Online team to bring the USS Resolute to a broader audience as a free ship in their game. Go claim her now - she'll be waiting for you until June 6, 2024. Go [url=https://www.playstartrekonline.com/en/news/article/11569097]here[/url] to read more.  

And on that note, we can announce that if you buy Resurgence on Steam and register your game using the in-game QR code, we'll email you a code for the Federation Elite Starter Pack for Star Trek Online. We have a limited number of keys and they have a December 2024 expiration date, so if you want one, be sure to register ASAP.

You can find out more about that [url=https://www.startrek-resurgence.com/sto-pc-offer]here[/url], all the rules, regulations and what you'll get are there, but it's a pack that'll give you a serious boost in a game that's still going strong after 14 years. 

On top of that, we're celebrating our launch by offering the standard and Captain's Editions of the game with a 20% discount for the first week of availability.

So again, thanks for being interested in our game. If you buy it, we're incredibly grateful, and if you enjoy it, then it's the ultimate achievement for us as fellow Star Trek fans. 

Please spread the word, and if you have a moment, write us a review. 

LLAP 

The ST: R Team

notes.title: A Captain's Edition, A 20% Discount, A Virtual Tour and A Spock Interview!
notes.notes:
Star Trek: Resurgence drops out of warp and onto Steam in One Week (May 23)!

And we have some announcements! 

- Dramatic Labs is excited to offer a special [b]Captain's Edition[/b] alongside the standard version of the game. It includes a [b]digital art book[/b] brimming with over 100 pages of concept art and developer notes (in English and German). Plus, you'll get the [b]original soundtrack[/b] featuring ten epic pieces of music, specially remastered by composer Jared Emerson-Johnson and performed by a live orchestra.

- Prepare for a discount worthy of the Ferengi Commerce Guild!  Both the standard and Captain's Editions will be available on Steam with a [b]launch week discount of 20%[/b], valid until May 30th. That means you can snag the standard edition for US$19.99 and the Captain's Edition for US$23.99 (or your regional equivalent).

- We've heard your requests loud and clear! We're beaming a new feature your way - a brand-new [b]virtual tour of the USS Resolute[/b] accessed via the game menu!  Explore iconic locations including the bridge, sickbay, and the brig - all meticulously designed to bring our Centaur-class refit to life.

- We’ve interviewed Piotr Michael, [b]the voice of Ambassador Spock[/b]. It still astounds us when he pays homage to Leonard Nimoy’s singular voice - we hope you have the same reaction that we do (there’s also a cheeky Kirk moment in there too!) 

[previewyoutube=juT40H8G2FE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

So - are you ready to boldly go?  Wishlist Star Trek: Resurgence today and prepare to leave Spacedock on May 23rd!

notes.title: Star Trek: Resurgence - Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the U.S.S. Resolute and her crew will enter orbit on Steam on [b]May 23rd, 2024[/b]! Expect further incoming transmissions before that date: we'll reveal more in the coming weeks!

In the meantime, look out for new, extended interviews with Captain Riker himself, the legendary [b]Jonathan Frakes[/b], new behind-the-scenes content, and much more! 

We're so excited to finally bring our game to Steam - [b]Wishlist now![/b]  

[i][u]Did you know:[/u] Our game's hero ship the U.S.S. Resolute is named after the HMS Resolute, which was lost to the ice on an exploratory mission to arctic waters in 1854. The HMS [b]Enterprise[/b] was also part of that expedition. After an American whaler discovered the Resolute, it was restored and returned to the British who used timbers from the ship to construct the Resolute desk, which was presented to the United States as a gift of thanks. It is now located in the White House Oval Office and has been used by many Presidents of the United States.[/i]
